config.source_energy: unit scalar monopole coefficient squared per exposure; same k and pulse duration
config.field_match_ablation: scale each near source by the incident-field norm ratio between corresponding far and near angles; equal grid-mean incident intensity
config.field_match_noise: same absolute receiver variance; unequal emitted energy is an ablation only
config.new_noise_calibration: equal absolute receiver variance estimated from old data norm
config.source_design_input: public noisy Y, public GN material, known operators
config.material_scores: Archived GN–NN convention: RMSE and amplitude-normalized RMSE, 256-bin Otsu-IoU against alpha >= .5
